author: 0xgrantscommittee
body: This proposal requests 750,000 USDC from the DAO treasury to fund the Q3 grants program. Funds will be distributed to builders through the grants committee with monthly reporting and a hard cap of 250,000 USDC per grant. Any unspent funds return to the treasury at quarter end. The committee multisig requires 3 of 5 signatures and all disbursements are published on the forum.
title: Treasury grant: 750,000 USDC for the Q3 builder program
